changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE warehouse ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_warehouse PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_warehouse_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE reservation_status ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_reservation_status PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_reservation_status_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: On-hand stock per product. The two check constraints are the last line of defence for the invariant the service maintains: holds never exceed the shelf, and neither goes negative.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE stock_item ( id UUID NOT NULL, product_id UUID NOT NULL, warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, reserved INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_stock_item PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_stock_item_product UNIQUE (product_id), CONSTRAINT fk_stock_item_warehouse FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouse (id), CONSTRAINT ck_stock_item_quantity CHECK (quantity >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_stock_item_reserved CHECK (reserved >= 0 AND reserved <= quantity) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: Stock held for one order. order_id is unique — that index is what makes a repeated Reserve find the existing hold instead of taking the stock a second time.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE reservation ( id UUID NOT NULL, order_id UUID NOT NULL, status_id BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_reservation PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_reservation_order UNIQUE (order_id), CONSTRAINT fk_reservation_status FOREIGN KEY (status_id) REFERENCES reservation_status (id) );
CREATE TABLE reservation_item ( id UUID NOT NULL, reservation_id UUID NOT NULL, product_id UUID NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_reservation_item PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_reservation_item_product UNIQUE (reservation_id, product_id), CONSTRAINT fk_reservation_item_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservation (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT ck_reservation_item_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE reservation_item; DROP TABLE reservation;

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: The sweeper query is (status, expires_at) — without this index every pass sorts the whole reservation table, and it only ever grows.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_reservation_status_expires ON reservation (status_id, expires_at); CREATE INDEX ix_reservation_item_reservation ON reservation_item (reservation_id);
changeSet.rollback: DROP INDEX ix_reservation_status_expires; DROP INDEX ix_reservation_item_reservation;
